text:
kevin: quick sync - customers keep retrying on 4xx and making things worse. we need a short, canonical mapping + a small runtime hint so SDKs don't guess. who can take this?

sam: i can. high-level idea: keep HTTP status for semantics, but expose an additive boolean `retryable` in the error envelope and optional `retry_after_seconds` and `client_action`. SDKs should prefer the flag.

maria: agree. current pain: we use 422 wildly (schema vs model refusals). proposal: 400 = param/schema validation (non-retryable), 422 = model rejection/safety (non-retryable), 413 = payload too large (non-retryable, give fix hint), 429 = rate limit (retryable), 502/503 = infra/transient (retryable).

ciara: +1. please include short actionable hint fields so UIs show how to fix. e.g. `client_action: truncate_history` or `reduce_batch`.

alex: also note: OOMs and model crashes previously returned 500. prefer 502/503 for upstream-dependency issues so clients can retry safely.

sam: suggested minimal envelope (additive):

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "short_code",
    "message": "human readable message",
    "retryable": true|false,
    "retry_after_seconds": 5,
    "client_action": "truncate_history|reduce_batch|check_params",
    "field_errors": ["messages[2]"]
  }
}
```

ciara: example for 413:

```http
HTTP/1.1 413 Payload Too Large
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "prompt_too_large",
    "message": "prompt length 12000 > max 8192 tokens",
    "retryable": false,
    "client_action": "truncate_history",
    "field_errors": ["messages[5]"]
  }
}
```

maria: rate-limit should include Retry-After header and the same field:

```http
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 12
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "rate_limited",
    "message": "burst limit exceeded",
    "retryable": true,
    "retry_after_seconds": 12
  }
}
```

sam: SDK guidance (docs blurb): prefer `error.retryable`; if absent, fallback to heuristics (5xx => retryable, 429 => retryable, 4xx => non-retryable except 429). when retrying, use exponential backoff + jitter and respect `Retry-After`/`retry_after_seconds`. surface `client_action` to users.

kevin: can you also draft a short rollout plan that won't break existing clients?

sam: plan: 1) server starts emitting `retryable` + hints (additive) 2) docs publish mapping + examples 3) SDKs update to prefer flag 4) monitor for 2 weeks and iterate. include compatibility note: fields are additive, existing status-code-only clients will keep working.

ciara: i'll follow up with an SDK issue to stop heuristics and show `client_action` in error UIs.

deploy-bot: created issue #3421: "standardize error envelope + retryable hint" -> linked to eng-platform/docs (https://go/repo/issue/3421)

kevin: great, @sam please draft the PR (docs + small runtime patch). i'll review first thing. thanks :thumbsup:
